history: Colonized in 2289 as a civilian settlement, Crucible Majoris was requisitioned for military use following the Border Wars of 2412.
The Crucible Forge Yards have produced over 400 capital ships since their establishment in 2445, making the system essential to Commonwealth naval power.
The prison colony on Penance was established in 2567 for high-security inmates; escape is considered impossible due to the planet's remoteness and harsh conditions.
description: Crucible Majoris burns bright under its yellow-white primary, six worlds arranged in testament to humanity's capacity for both creation and destruction. The system's name reflects its purpose: a crucible where naval power is forged, where soldiers are tempered, and where the unwanted are sent to cool in the outer dark. From the industrial hellscape of Forge to the frozen exile of Penance, each world serves the Commonwealth's military machine with grim efficiency.

Temperance alone retains civilian character—a garden world of 6.2 billion whose taxes and industries support the military infrastructure surrounding them. High Temperance station handles both commercial traffic and naval logistics, its docking bays a study in contrasts between merchant freighters and warship tenders. The Crucible Forge Yards work ceaselessly, their orbital facilities glowing with the light of construction lasers as new vessels take shape. The Commonwealth's dominance in this sector flows from these shipyards.

The system's military nature creates both security and tension. Civilians on Temperance live under naval jurisdiction for 'security purposes,' their communications monitored, their travel restricted. The Proving Ground asteroid belt regularly echoes with weapons fire as fleets conduct exercises. And on distant Penance, 2 million prisoners serve sentences in conditions that human rights organizations have condemned but cannot investigate. Crucible Majoris builds the Commonwealth's power, but the cost of that power is measured in freedoms surrendered and lives confined.
